Thank you so much for supporting our little self-serve stand and shopping local!

A little backstory on my business & why your support means the world to my little family. 🩷🍞

My name is Emily, and I’m a mom to two sweet little girls. Three years ago, after escaping a very rough situation, my daughters and I were starting over. As a single mom, I was desperate to find a way to provide for my little family while staying home with my kids as much as possible—and that’s how B&S Express was born. (Fun fact: “B&S” stands for my daughter’s initials!)

Today, B&S Express is my full-time business and the sole income supporting my little family. Every single penny you spend here goes directly toward providing for my girls and helping our dreams come true.

I now have two locations: The Original Bread Barn in Grand Junction, open every Friday at 158 29 1/2 Road GJ 81503, and a pickup-only location strictly for pre-orders in Cortez near the co-op for when I’m in town and can bring fresh goodies! 
(Huge thank you to my better half for building me my brand new little pickup stand for a quick convenient pickup experience in Cortez) 

I want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who has ever supported me and continues to support me and my family. I am operating at full capacity every Friday (and possibly more days to come!) now through December, leading up to a huge Christmas sale!

Looking ahead to 2027:
While I will be moving my weekly sales to Cortez starting in 2027, The Bread Barn is staying put! (Yes you read that right!) Located at 158 29 1/2 Road, it will remain my official Grand Junction spot for monthly sales next year. I won’t be gone for good—my sourdough products will just be available on a monthly schedule here in Grand Junction instead of weekly. Be sure to keep your text alerts on and keep following along on my Facebook page next year so you never miss my sales!

If you haven’t tried my baked goods yet and want to support a local mother who built this business from the ground up through blood, sweat, tears, and countless sleepless nights, I’d love for you to give B&S Express a try.

How to shop:
•Pre-order: Order directly on my website for guaranteed Friday pickup.
Link can be found on my Facebook home page under the links section or simply Google “B&S Express Sourdough Bakery”
•Shop in person: Grab extra inventory at The Bread Barn every Friday starting at 9:00 AM!
📍 Location: 158 29 1/2 Rd, Grand Junction, CO 81503 (Conveniently located off Hwy 50 in Orchard Mesa, between the Kia dealership and 29 Rd, behind Chipeta Golf Course).
